episodes.title: Chapter I: The Gales
episodes.summary: A sudden attack by the mysterious Gales prompts Queen Sorsha to seek help from an old friend.

episodes.title: Chapter II: The High Aldwin
episodes.summary: The Nelwyns welcome the outsiders to meet with their High Aldwin leader.

episodes.title: Chapter III: The Battle of the Slaughtered Lamb
episodes.summary: The young heroes led by Willow are pursued by assassins who have been infected by dark magic.

episodes.title: Chapter IV: The Whispers of Nockmaar
episodes.summary: The journey leads the adventurers to seek refuge in the haunted castle of Nockmaar.

episodes.title: Chapter V: Wildwood
episodes.summary: Desperate to escape the Gales, Willow leads the group into the Wildwood, the unpredictable, enchanted forest, home to the infamous Bone Reavers.

episodes.title: Chapter VI: Prisoners of Skellin
episodes.summary: The heroes mount a rescue mission into the Dread Mines of Skellin.

episodes.title: Chapter VII: Beyond the Shattered Sea
episodes.summary: Our heroes finally reach the place where all maps end: the infinite expanse of the Shattered Sea.

episodes.title: Chapter VIII: Children of the Wyrm
episodes.summary: Beyond the edge of the world lies the Immemorial City, a ruined place of eternal evil. The Crone awaits our heroes.
